title: Completeness of the input consistency tester
statement: Let $n>0$, let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $w$ be any input word. When given $w$ together with the proof encoding the circuit’s canonical quadratic witness for $w$, the circuit’s input consistency tester accepts with probability $1$.
